title: Theme Park World PSX (SLES-026.88): main menu, language screen and Now Loading artwork -> FOLIO.GAZ entries
method: VRAM+RAM dumps from save state fable/b/states/lang4700.st (CROSS at rel 20) at rel 5 (language), 60 (jester), 450 (menu); sheet blocks hash-tied to VRAM; GPU display lists reconstructed from RAM (m/dlist.py); 2D layers re-rendered from disc data (m/recon.py) and compared with the emulator frames.

vram_layout.sheet_84: (512..895, 256..511) = texture pages 0x18..0x1d, 6 pages in a row
vram_layout.empty: (512..895, 0..255) is black on all three screens

84.format: texture sheet, compressed=1 (0x10 header + 136 sprites x12 + 1 free rect, then UNPAK'd 64x64-halfword blocks, block 0 raw)
84.vram_tie: 20/20 non-blank 8 KB blocks hash-equal to the frame-450 VRAM dump at the header's predicted positions; 17/20 at frames 5 and 60 (the 3 others are the flag slot and its CLUT row, rewritten at runtime)
84.ram_tie: header+sprite table (1648 bytes) verbatim in RAM on all three screens
84.role: the FRONT-END sheet: curtains, floor, logo, glow, big orange font, 7 flags, flag slot, flagpole, PS button icons

416.vram_tie: 16/16 non-blank blocks hash-equal at frames 5, 60 and 450
416.ram_tie: header+sprite table (10744 bytes) verbatim in RAM
416.role: in-game UI sheet; here it supplies the advisor/jester textures and the small white font of 'Now Loading...'

83.ram_tie: whole entry verbatim in RAM at frames 5, 90, 450 (absent at 60)
83.role: sub 0-9: the advisor, 72 verts/12 bones/103 faces each, identical face UV sets, different vertex poses and animation tracks; sub 10: advisor + flagpole + flag as one 205-vert/29-bone/319-face mesh

0.format: 0x96 model pack, 17 meshes, sub 0 LZ-compressed (0x800BFD9C) to 0x3fc8 bytes
0.ram_tie: whole entry verbatim in RAM on all three screens
0.role: sub 0 = the jester (advisor in jester hat), 193 verts/17 bones/301 faces

menu_curtains.draw: 6 opaque POLY_FT4 (0x2c): drape at (10,5)-(132,129) and mirrored at (392,5)-(514,129); valance at (132,5)-(267,58) and mirrored (270,5)-(405,58); side drape at (10,129)-(101,245) and mirrored (423,129)-(514,245). Sprites 1 and 3 are stored rotated (flags bit0): screen x runs along v, screen y along u.
tied_by: display list quads name these uv rects and CLUTs

menu_logo.draw: left half (rotated) at (87,66)-(253,136), right half at (253,64)-(424,137); opaque 0x2c, shade 0x80

menu_highlight_glow.draw: 3 additive POLY_FT4 (0x2e, abr=1) behind the selected item: cap at (105,130)-(174,174), mirrored cap at (338,130)-(407,174), strip stretched over (174,130)-(338,174). Moves with the highlight.

menu_spotlight.draw: 35 semi-transparent Gouraud quads (0x3a) per frame, two vertices at the off-screen apex (-103,-64), the other two ~15 px apart on an arc through (411,319)..(644,113); colours 0x000000 / 0x001818 (BBGGRR = dark yellow), additive via a degenerate textured tri (0x27) that latches tpage 0x0020 (abr=1). The arc end moves every frame: this is the sweeping beam.

menu_font.notes: A-Z 9-34, 0-9 35-44, 20 punctuation 45-64 (read visually: png/s84_punct_45-64_x3.png), a-z 65-90, accents 91-100 (read visually). Menu items are opaque POLY_GT4 (0x3c) shaded 0x808080, disabled 'Load Game' shaded 0x202020; the highlighted item is not recoloured, the additive glow behind it does it. Verified letters from the drawn strings: P l a y G m e O p t i o n s L d E N S F v k r g h c(ç) n(ñ).
tied_by: display list glyph rects -> sprite table

language_background.draw: one Gouraud quad (0x38) (0,0)-(512,256), top colour BBGGRR 0xfea399 = RGB(153,163,254), bottom 0x57202a = RGB(42,32,87)

language_flags.mechanism: the flag mesh samples sprite #126 (page 0x1a, uv (1,88), 150x87, CLUT 0x40e0 at (512,259)); on the disc that slot holds the 'TPW Boot Boys' placeholder. The game copies the selected flag's 150x87 texels into the slot and its 16-entry CLUT row into (512,259).
language_flags.verified: English: slot == #120 (97.4% of halfwords, edge column differs by nibble alignment) and CLUT row == #120's; after LEFT (Nederlands): slot == #119 and its CLUT. The other five are named by the flag itself.

language_advisor_flagpole.format: skinned mesh: 205 verts, 29 bones, 319 faces, 29 tracks
language_advisor_flagpole.textures: advisor: sheet 416 sprites (see advisor_textures); flag: 192 tris on page 0x1a CLUT 0x40e0 (the slot); pole: 2 flat tris on page 0x18 CLUT 0x40e1 = sprite #127 (6x88)
tied_by: 217/217 distinct drawn (uv,clut,page) triangles are faces of sub 10
RAM pointers: 7 into sub 10 (4 at +0, 1 at +0x48 = vertices)

language_arrows.draw: 8 semi-transparent flat triangles (0x22), 4 chevrons each side at y 192..216, x 77..157 and 353..433 mirrored, colours BBGGRR 0x011012, 0x053d44, 0x096a76, 0x0d97a8 (dark to gold), additive

language_names.draw: same big font, but POLY_GT4 semi-transparent (0x3e, abr=1 additive) shaded 0x646464 (centre), 0x2e2e2e (neighbours), 0x191919 (outer) over the blue gradient: that is what makes them look pink/lilac

menu_advisor.format: skinned mesh: 72 verts, 12 bones, 103 faces, 12 tracks (sub 0-9 share the face UV set; RAM pointers at frame 450 select sub 7)
tied_by: 23/26 distinct drawn textured triangles are faces of sub 0-9's shared set; the 8 others are scan junk
RAM pointers: 12 into sub 7 (4 at +0, 1 at +0x48)

jester.format: skinned mesh, LZ sub-entry: 193 verts, 17 bones, 301 faces, 17 tracks
jester.textures: sheet 416: eyes #0 (clut 0x8f8), #3 (0x8fb), body sphere #4 (0x938), flat colours 1x1 #23 (0x7a), #24 (0x7b), #25 (0x7c), #31 (0xb9) for the hat and bells
jester.background: same gradient quad as the language screen
tied_by: 32/37 distinct drawn triangles are faces of entry 0 sub 0; the 5 others are scan junk
entry 0 resident throughout; entry 83 NOT resident at frame 60

loading_font.order: A-Z at 410-435, a-z at 466-491, '.' at 463: same charset order as the big font shifted by +401 (big 'A'=9, small 'A'=410)
loading_font.draw: opaque POLY_GT4 (0x3c) shaded 0x808080, glyphs 8-13 px, baseline y 220, x 208..306

extras_in_sheet_84.japanese_leftovers: sprites 8, 101-113, 116-118 are Japanese menu strings and a small 'theme Park' logo (#107), unused on this disc's screens

not_established: which of entry 83's ten poses (sub 0-9) plays at other moments of the menu idle/point animation; only frame 450 (P+430) was read: sub 7
the exact GPU command the game uses to fill the flag slot (a 0x80 VRAM copy or a draw into the texture page); only the resulting VRAM was measured

punctuation and accent glyph identities were read by eye from png/s84_punct_45-64_x3.png and s84_accents_91-100_x3.png; big-font #62 looks like an apostrophe while the small font's #463 (same order slot) is the period used by 'Now Loading...'
no rendered PNG of the three meshes (advisor, advisor+flag, jester); their textures and entry/sub ids are given instead
the Options/Play Game submenus and the 'Load Game' with a save present were not captured
